description: Search xmlvalid's catalog of official XML schemas (UBL, CII, Peppol, XRechnung, Factur-X, ISO 20022, HL7, sitemaps…) by name, namespace, root element or area. Returns each schema's slug to pass to validate_xml, its version and the business rules it checks. No sign-in or API key needed.

query.description: Words to look for, such as "peppol invoice", "xrechnung cii" or "pain.001". Leave out to list the first schemas.

name: search_schemas

namespace.description: The target namespace; empty when it has none.

rules.description: The business rule sets checked after the schema, by name.

schema.description: The slug to pass to validate_xml as schema.

shown.description: Schemas listed, at most 25; add words to narrow the search.

title: Search XML schemas
